## Summary

What changed, and why?

## User-facing impact

Describe any effect on terminal UI, reports, commands, packaging, documentation, or operator workflow. Write `None` if there is no user-facing change.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests pass
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes where applicable
- [ ] Security checks were considered for the change
- [ ] No real credentials, customer data, or production logs were added
- [ ] Detection or incident wording does not overstate certainty
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior or UX changed

## Security / privacy impact

Does this change log collection, parsing, redaction, external data transfer, remote AI behavior, host interaction, or remediation behavior? If yes, explain the boundary clearly.

## Evidence

Include concise test output, screenshots, or reproduction notes when they materially help review. Product screenshots must be genuine captures from a verified build using sanitized or synthetic telemetry.
